date_policy: Event dates separated from document publication dates. Dates in later official narrative are reported chronology, not contemporaneous unmediated minutes. May compromise facsimile only month-dated.
classification_policy: An unaccepted proposal, a reported request for authority, public support, final schedule and actual implementation are separate objects. Handwritten ticks on EU proposal do not prove assent. Later narration and reproduced documents in same volume are source-dependent.
